blocks.title: Write an email in 120–150 words for the following situation. Use the checklist in exercise A and the language in this section to help you.

items.prompt: An English-speaking friend is spending a week’s holiday in your home town. You are going to be away, so write an email to your friend giving advice about their stay.

blocks.heading: GRAMMAR · Future plans
blocks.copy: Use the future forms from the workbook: be going to, might, have got to, be thinking of + -ing, Present Continuous arrangements, will / probably.

blocks.title: Rewrite the sentences with the words in brackets.

items.prompt: We will definitely be away in June. (going)
items.exampleAnswer: We’re going to be away in June.

items.prompt: Perhaps I’ll try couch-surfing this year. (might)
answer: I might try couch-surfing this year.
I might try couch surfing this year.

items.prompt: I can’t meet up this weekend. I have to revise for my exams. (got)
items.answer: I’ve got to revise for my exams.

items.prompt: Jim might go travelling this summer. (thinking)
answer: Jim is thinking of going travelling this summer.
Jim’s thinking of going travelling this summer.

items.prompt: I think it will be too cold for swimming. (probably)
items.answer: It will probably be too cold for swimming.

items.prompt: They definitely won’t be on holiday in July. (going)
answer: They definitely aren’t going to be on holiday in July.
They definitely are not going to be on holiday in July.

blocks.title: Use the words in 1–7 to complete the students’ replies to the teacher’s question.
blocks.instructions: What are you doing at the weekend?

items.prompt: It’s such a busy time! Why do they arrange exams at the end of term? (I / got / study for / my university entrance exam)
answer: I’ve got to study for my university entrance exam.
I have got to study for my university entrance exam.

items.prompt: I’m not sure yet but (my friends and I / think / go / camping / near the coast)
answer: My friends and I are thinking of going camping near the coast.
My friends and I’re thinking of going camping near the coast.

items.prompt: (Marek and I / go to / a concert / in Manchester on Friday) We need to leave class early to get the train.
answer: Marek and I are going to a concert in Manchester on Friday.
Marek and I’re going to a concert in Manchester on Friday.

items.prompt: I’m not sure. (I / might / meet up with some friends in London)
items.answer: I might meet up with some friends in London.

items.prompt: (I / got / a free weekend) I’m going to catch up on some sleep.
answer: I have got a free weekend.

items.prompt: (my sister and I / not go / be around) We’ve been invited to a party in Brighton.
answer: My sister and I aren’t going to be around.
My sister and I are not going to be around.

items.prompt: I haven’t made any plans but (I / probably / go to / my friend’s barbecue)
answer: I’ll probably go to my friend’s barbecue.
I will probably go to my friend’s barbecue.
